# 1 Clement 45 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Clement 45 (7 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.2 — "counterfeit" / "falsified" / "distorted"
- **EMET:** "counterfeit" / **LOGOS:** "falsified" / **PNEUMA:** "distorted"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Falsified" — the Greek *nenotheuménon* implies deliberate adulteration of authentic material; "falsified" captures both the intentional quality and the contrast with "true" in v.1.

---

## V.3 — "unholy" / "impious" / "godless"
- **EMET:** "unholy" / **LOGOS:** "impious" / **PNEUMA:** "godless"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Godless" — the Greek *anomoi* (lawless) and *asebeis* (impious/godless) appear as a set; PNEUMA's rendering is most accessible without losing the theological force.

---

## V.6 — "champion and protector" / "defender and protector" / "champion and defender"
- **EMET:** "champion and protector" / **LOGOS:** "defender and protector" / **PNEUMA:** "champion and defender"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Champion and protector" — preserves the two-sided Greek *antilambanomenos kai hyperaspistēs* (one who takes up a cause + one who shields).

---

## V.6 — Naming of the three (Ananias, Azarias, Misael)
- **EMET/LOGOS:** use Hebrew/LXX names throughout / **PNEUMA:** notes but does not gloss the Babylonian name variants
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Retain the LXX names as Clement uses them. A footnote noting the equivalence to Shadrach, Meshach, Abednego is appropriate but not required in-text.

---

*— SOPHIA*
